title: Grade 4 SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — General Assessment #19

pages.quiz:
SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. The stomach is described in the lesson as being like (1 mark)
   A. A hard stone
   B. A sharp knife
   C. A stretchy bag
   D. A long ladder

2. What effect of force is shown when a goalkeeper stops a ball? (1 mark)
   A. Starts a moving object
   B. Changes its colour
   C. Makes it lighter
   D. Stops a moving object

3. What should you do with a small animal after you observe it? (1 mark)
   A. Give it to a friend
   B. Take it home in your pocket
   C. Return it to where you found it
   D. Squash it

4. In the dry tissue experiment, why does the tissue stay dry? (1 mark)
   A. The tissue is warm
   B. Air in the cup keeps the water out
   C. Water cannot touch paper
   D. The cup is made of plastic

5. Which of these uses sunlight to dry things? (1 mark)
   A. Drying clothes and grain
   B. Making ice
   C. Making stones
   D. Making rain only

6. What happens to a gas that is put in a closed jar? (1 mark)
   A. It stays at the bottom
   B. It sits at the top only
   C. It becomes a solid
   D. It spreads to fill the whole jar

7. Which state of matter has its own shape and fixed volume? (1 mark)
   A. Gas
   B. Liquid
   C. Steam only
   D. Solid

8. Which of these is a difference between plants and animals? (1 mark)
   A. Plants die but animals do not
   B. Plants breathe and animals do not
   C. Animals do not grow
   D. Animals move from place to place and take in ready-made food

9. Which of these is needed to harvest rainwater from a roof? (1 mark)
   A. A ladder only
   B. A fan
   C. A torch
   D. A gutter and a tank

10. What is diarrhoea? (1 mark)
   A. A swollen stomach
   B. Passing loose watery faeces many times
   C. Food coming out of the mouth
   D. Passing hard dry faeces

11. What is a vertebrate? (1 mark)
   A. An animal that lives in water only
   B. An animal with six legs
   C. An animal with a backbone
   D. An animal without bones

12. Why do farmers dry maize in the sun before storing it? (1 mark)
   A. So it starts to grow
   B. So it becomes heavier
   C. So it does not rot or grow mould
   D. So it becomes wetter

13. Which of these is a natural source of light? (1 mark)
   A. A torch
   B. A bulb
   C. The sun
   D. A candle

14. Which of these makes its own light? (1 mark)
   A. A mirror
   B. A glow-worm
   C. A white wall
   D. A shiny cup

15. Which of these gives out heat when rubbed? (1 mark)
   A. A leaf
   B. A stone table
   C. Hands
   D. A book in a bag

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain the difference between diarrhoea and constipation. (4 marks)

17. Explain how a school can manage waste at the kitchen, classrooms and playground. (4 marks)

18. Explain the importance of conserving water at home and school. (5 marks)

19. Name two things a farmer can do to save water. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — A stretchy bag
   The stomach is a stretchy bag that churns food.

2. D — Stops a moving object
   The force of the hands stops the ball.

3. C — Return it to where you found it
   Animals should be returned to their home.

4. B — Air in the cup keeps the water out
   Air takes up the space inside the cup.

5. A — Drying clothes and grain
   Sunlight dries wet things.

6. D — It spreads to fill the whole jar
   A gas fills any container it is in.

7. D — Solid
   Solids keep their shape and volume.

8. D — Animals move from place to place and take in ready-made food
   Most animals move about and eat food, while plants make their own food.

9. D — A gutter and a tank
   Gutters carry rain to a tank.

10. B — Passing loose watery faeces many times
   Diarrhoea means loose watery faeces.

11. C — An animal with a backbone
   Vertebrates have a backbone.

12. C — So it does not rot or grow mould
   Heat dries the grain and dry grain keeps longer.

13. C — The sun
   The sun is found in nature.

14. B — A glow-worm
   Glow-worms produce their own light.

15. C — Hands
   Rubbing produces heat through friction.

SECTION B
----
16. (4 marks)
   Answer: Diarrhoea is passing loose watery faeces many times and causes loss of water. Constipation is passing hard dry faeces with difficulty.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each condition.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: Kitchen: compost pit for food waste and separate bin for plastic. Classroom: bin with lid and paper box. Playground: bins and monitors who pick litter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each place and 1 mark for a clear system.

18. (5 marks)
   Answer: There is enough water for all, we save money, animals and crops get water, it reduces work of fetching water and protects sources.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason up to 5.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Use drip irrigation, use mulch, water at cooler times, harvest rainwater.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.
